title: 10 am Baby Goat Yoga at the L.A. Arboretum
description: Get ready for a fun-filled morning of Goat Yoga at the beautiful L.A. Arboretum, starting at 10 am!
long_description:
Get ready for a fun-filled morning of Goat Yoga at the beautiful L.A. Arboretum, starting at 10 am!

About this Event 
 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events1/banners/f66d8f00-9619-11f1-b940-55345dfad50a-rimg-w572-h740-dcf8f8f8-gmir.jpg 

Enjoy communing with gentle goats while engaging in a fun, light-hearted practice taught by a certified yoga instructor. Connect with your “inner kid” while moving through an all-levels practice; suitable for first-timers who ”just came for the goats” as well as experienced yogis looking for new challenges!

 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events4/banners/f8087a50-9619-11f1-b940-55345dfad50a-rimg-w703-h740-dc080808-gmir.jpg 

Our Nigerian Dwarf kids will open your heart, widen your smile, deepen your stretch & strengthen your core as they weave thru class, interacting with each participant; nimbly jumping on, rebounding off, trotting under & crawling through various postures of the human playground created by attendees. 

 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events8/banners/f8bc8810-9619-11f1-b940-55345dfad50a-rimg-w925-h740-dc282838-gmir.jpg 

Not your typical yoga class...
Bring your love for animals and your sense of humor!

 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events8/banners/fa1169b0-9619-11f1-b940-55345dfad50a-rimg-w925-h740-dc383848-gmir.jpg 

 Your Goat Yoga ticket includes:
Goat Yoga taught by a certified instructorPetting, playing & photoshoot with the goatsAll-day admission to the park! Explore 127 acres of plants, natural landscapes, wildlife and historic buildings. 

 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events7/banners/fb6b0640-9619-11f1-b940-55345dfad50a-rimg-w983-h740-dc080808-gmir.png 

Grab a bite to eat at the Peacock Cafe after class!

 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events4/banners/fcb19000-9619-11f1-b940-55345dfad50a-rimg-w1110-h740-dca8a898-gmir.jpg
